test_title: PYST 45: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: To be eligible for membership of a State Legislature, a candidate must meet which of the following qualifications as laid down in the Representation of the People Act, 1951?

options.text: Be an elector (voter) in any State assembly constituency
Pay income tax in the State
Have at least a graduate degree
Be a permanent resident of the State for 15 years

solution:
The correct answer is __**Be an elector (voter) in any State assembly constituency**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• To be eligible for membership in a State Legislature, a candidate must satisfy specific qualifications as per the Representation of the People Act, 1951.
 
• One of the fundamental eligibility criteria is that the candidate must be an elector (voter) in any State assembly constituency.
